data.description: Qualify exact 16Kx1/64Kx1 suppliers, speed, rails, refresh and period volume supply, especially December 1979.
Freeze DRAM controller implementation, connector, pinout, rails, byte enables and timing; full-width does not mean zero waits.
Assign RAM/ROM/video RAM/I/O/reset address ranges without changing 24-bit physical addressing.
Baseline has no parity; optional 18-chip modules need a separately approved BOM and error path.
Select exact FDD/HDD mechanisms, interfaces, formats, OEM assembly boundaries and incoming test.
Freeze display OEM kits, receiver/DAC/analog boundaries, raster and calibration.
Aurelia family video RAM organization and count fixed: eight AION 4116-equivalent 16Kx1 DRAM chips. Qualify memory process, pinout, rails, timing, refresh and tests. Cartridge capacities remain open.

Aurelia and Aurelia+ each have three independent point-to-point ports. Qualify simultaneous keyboard/disk/printer service, port power and transceivers; freeze controller ports per die and resulting die quantity.
Qualify fixed 320/640 raster profiles and bidirectional Control identification. Freeze sync/porches, electrical levels, termination, connector and capability packet encoding.
Mono Pro console offers explicitly include keyboard/monitor; original server-only offers still require validated headless operation or a separately purchased console.
Specify die/package/process, fabrication versus outsource, yield, test and NRE for every custom chip.

Agreement and staged October 1979 sales are story commitments, not measured engineering proof. Freeze SMC process/mask compatibility, part-specific qualification dates, video RAM process margins, order codes, NRE and independent purchase quotes.
